PB15-D05.name: ［Halloween Zombie］Fongneena
PB15-D05.effect:
[team: Absolutes]

[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Yellow Core][Yellow Core])]
[During Set]
Once per turn, when your "Fongneena" would leave the Field due to opposing effects, by sending a core, besides the [Soul Core], from your Trash to the Void, one of them remains on the Field in the same state.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to any "Fongneena" you control.

PB18-X03.name: ［School Festival Princess］Fongneena
PB18-X03.effect:
[team: Absolutes]

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, addd every "Fongneena" to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, by sending a core from this Spirit to the Trash, refresh a "Fongneena" you control.
